summary: Parse both supplied certificate files as complete JSON and expose only their top-level schema and canonical SHA-256 digests, failing closed on unreadable, non-UTF-8, or non-canonical JSON.
script:
import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
names=['attempt-research-plan-task-35.stdout.txt','attempt-research-plan-task-36.09b3808ea515.stdout.txt']
out={}
for name in names:
    p=Path(name)
    try:
        raw=p.read_bytes()
        text=raw.decode('utf-8')
        obj=json.loads(text)
        canon=json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)
        # Complete-JSON check: JSONDecoder must consume all non-whitespace.
        dec=json.JSONDecoder(); _, end=dec.raw_decode(text.lstrip())
        if text.lstrip()[end:].strip(): raise ValueError('trailing non-whitespace after JSON')
        out[name]={
          'top_type':type(obj).__name__,
          'top_keys':sorted(obj.keys()) if isinstance(obj,dict) else None,
          'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
          'canonical_sha256':hashlib.sha256(canon.encode()).hexdigest(),
          'canonical_length':len(canon),
          'value_summaries':{k:(type(v).__name__,len(v) if isinstance(v,(list,dict,str)) else None) for k,v in obj.items()} if isinstance(obj,dict) else None
        }
    except Exception as e:
        raise SystemExit('FAIL-CLOSED '+name+': '+repr(e))
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
